title: laurus fragrans
intro: Laurus fragrans, commonly known as sweet bay, is a flowering plant native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Laurus fragrans include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Laurus fragrans include eugenol, cineole, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and aromatherapeutic benefits.
